QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 1 (Cole)
QuestInfo.0: Cole,  the elephant from the Republican party, has a request.
QuestInfo.1: Aliens made a mess of the Speaking Hall. Go in and take out the Grays!
QuestInfo.2: Return to Cole and let him know that you got rid of the Barnard Grays.

0.0: Everything was going fine until those aliens waltzed in here and started loitering around with their ray guns and their space heads... which was completely within their rights as American citizens, but come on! The only truly patriotic thing for you to do would be to go kick all of their behinds back into space.
0.1: That's what George Washington would have wanted, right?

yes.0: Go give those aliens a little taste of the old stars and stripes.

no.0: You, sir or madame, are a communist. Right? I'm just guessing.

1.0: You don't look very tired from alien-beatings. I think you might want to head back.

yes.0: The world will remember you as the person who single-handedly saved democracy... at a small-time presidential debate.

mob.0: Are you SCARED of aliens sneaking into your bedroom at night to exact their evil revenge? Seriously?
